name: coreweave-skills
description: CoreWeave Cloud customer-facing skills. Install one plugin per product line you use.

plugins.name: coreweave-platform-skills
plugins.description: Cross-cutting CoreWeave Cloud platform skills: API tokens, kubeconfig, Grafana verification, IAM. Foundation skills used by every product-line plugin.

plugins.name: coreweave-cks-skills
plugins.description: CoreWeave Kubernetes Service (CKS) workflows: deploy clusters, manage node pools, install operators, troubleshoot pods.

plugins.name: coreweave-storage-skills
plugins.description: CoreWeave storage workflows: provision object buckets, mount distributed file systems, manage persistent volumes and data movement.

plugins.name: coreweave-networking-skills
plugins.description: CoreWeave networking workflows: configure VPCs, load balancers, ingress, BGP peering, and cross-region connectivity.

plugins.name: coreweave-sunk-skills
plugins.description: SUNK (Slurm on Kubernetes) workflows: provision Slurm clusters, submit jobs, manage queues, troubleshoot scheduler issues on CoreWeave.
